text: Astronomy investigates celestial bodies, space, and the entire universe. Within our solar system, objects orbit the Sun; certain bodies possess their own moons. Earth travels in an elliptical path around this star. The Moon's orbital circumference measures about 239,000 miles. Meteoroids are tiny particles moving through space that leave bright streaks as they enter Earth's atmosphere and become meteors. Some meteors vaporize fully, while others reach the surface to create craters. Craters found on Earth and other planets offer insights into cosmic formation and development.
